facts.fact: Agence Ecofin reports SMTD-SA and Senegal Numerique commissioned on 5 October 2026 a fibre link at Kidira-Diboli joining the Malian and Senegalese backbones, giving landlocked Mali a route to submarine cables (2Africa, ACE, SAT-3 landing in Senegal) and described as an additional corridor to a pre-existing terrestrial axis it does not name.

note: Link to Senegal in service 5 Oct 2026; article implies an earlier route but names none, so only one is recorded.
